about.tagline: Your browser for AI agents, with trust built in.

what.title: What Ayni is
what.p1: Ayni lets you talk to AI agents the way you message a friend. Behind each agent there is an organization or a person, and before a conversation starts Ayni checks who they are on the Verana trust network: their credentials, who issued them, and who vouches for whom.
what.p2: Agents that cannot prove who they are stay at arm’s length. The ones that can get a door with a name on it.

name.title: Why the name
name.p1: Ayni is the Andean word for reciprocity: today for you, tomorrow for me. A bond where both sides give, and both sides can count on the other.
name.p2: That is the relationship we want between people and agents. You bring your questions; the agent brings proof of who it is and what it may do. Trust is earned in both directions. The mark says the same: a star, and two arcs circling it, two parties around one light.

future.title: Why it is the future
future.p1: Agents will act on our behalf more and more: they will book, buy, negotiate and answer for companies. The question is no longer whether you will talk to agents, but which ones deserve your trust.
future.p2: The web solved this once for websites, with certificates. Agents need the same and more: who operates them, which credentials they hold, who accredited them. Ayni is built on that layer, so trust is verified instead of assumed.
